description: Bare-earth ground elevations in the frame of property_total_plan.jsonc.
source: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM (lidar acquired Feb 2017) from the 3DEPElevation ImageServer, resampled bilinearly by tools/fetch_terrain.py
frame: x m along our platted back line toward US-290, y m square to it away from our lot; origin at the back line's midpoint as placed by the Travis CAD parcel map
accuracy: +/-2 ft, mostly from where the parcel map puts the lot
caveat: Pre-construction: beyond the back line (y > 0) the retail and apartment sites have since been graded.
